verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented on Restate's AI-assistant page. That page frames the integration as helping coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor build Restate apps, so the server appears to serve documentation and guidance rather than letting an agent operate Restate services, invocations or state. Missing for 10: any detail on the MCP server's tools and setup, evidence that it exposes Restate operations (invoke handlers, inspect invocations or state), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
